our_title: Hoboken Rent Control: annual rent increase cap (§ 155-5)
our_notes: Section history shows 'Amended 2-1-2023 by Ord. No. B-532'. The text does not say whether that amendment changed the cap, and no operative date is stated, so effective_date is null. Other terms in the chapter: vacancy decontrol allows a 25% increase on a new tenant's initial rent (§ 155-31, once per three years per unit); a Board-approved capital improvement surcharge may not raise base rent by more than 33 1/3% in 12 months (§ 155-10); tax, water/sewer and hardship surcharges are available with Board or Officer approval. The COVID moratorium (§ 155-38) ended May 7, 2022.

our_notes: Section 3 says the act takes effect on the first day of the fourth month next following enactment. The CPI adjustment begins January 1 of the year after enactment (2027), applies only if CPI change is greater than zero, and the Director of Consumer Affairs publishes the adjusted limit annually.

our_citation: Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 13.76 (Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Good Cause Ordinance), as amended by Measure BB (Nov. 2024)
our_title: Berkeley just cause eviction rules as amended by Measure BB
our_notes: Measure BB passed in the November 2024 election; the document states no operative date for the eviction changes, so effective_date is null. Lease-breach evictions require a material, mutually agreed term, substantial actual damage and unreasonable tenant behavior. Notices must direct tenants to the Rent Board, and copies of notices and lawsuits must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days. Owner move-in relocation assistance is adjusted for inflation annually; no amounts are given. Notice of Tenant Rights applies to tenancies started on or after 2024-12-20, which is an application date, not an effective date.
